name: Crispy Gnocchi with Burst Tomatoes and Mozzarella
englishName: Crispy Gnocchi with Burst Tomatoes and Mozzarella
description: Pan-seared crispy gnocchi folded into cherry tomatoes burst in garlicky butter, topped with fresh mozzarella and basil and broiled until bubbling and browned in spots. 25 minutes. Serves 3.

ingredients.text: 500 g shelf-stable or refrigerated potato gnocchi
225 g fresh mozzarella, torn into pieces

steps.text: Heat the broiler with a rack 15 cm from the heat.

Heat 2 tbsp of 3 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil in a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high. Add 500 g shelf-stable or refrigerated potato gnocchi in one layer, cover, and cook 4 minutes, until golden underneath. Stir and cook 2 minutes more. Transfer to a plate.

Lower the heat to medium, add 2 tbsp unsalted butter and cook 1 minute, until golden-brown. Add 3 garlic cloves, thinly sliced, 1/2 tsp red chili flakes, 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp black pepper and stir 30 seconds.
Add 450 g cherry or grape tomatoes and 60 ml water, cover and cook 5 minutes, until the tomatoes soften and start to burst. Press them with a spoon to release their juices.
Stir in the gnocchi and most of 15 g basil leaves. Top with 225 g fresh mozzarella, torn into pieces and drizzle with the remaining oil.
Broil 3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and browned in spots. Scatter with the rest of the basil and serve from the pan.

notes: Inspired by Ali Slagle's NYT Cooking recipe. Use an ovenproof skillet (cast iron is ideal). Pat the mozzarella dry so it browns rather than weeps.
